why:
Perched on act-brawler, in scn-tavern with act-patron — both party members, both placed (steps 7-8). This is the seat for ability use and conditions BETWEEN two characters: step 9 has the brawler swing at the patron, and step 12 removes a condition from the patron. Those two steps produce FOUR entries, not two: abilityUsed (evt-9), resourceChanged (evt-10), conditionApplied (evt-11) and conditionRemoved (evt-12). AbilityUsed takes the knows() arm; the other three take a STRICTER one -- passIf(pr.actors[id]), forwarded only to a viewer that ALREADY HELD the actor. The two arms are indistinguishable here because act-patron is held from seq 4, which is exactly why a wrong claim about which gate applies survives the reconciliation. Neither is sight-gated. Steps 10, 11, 13 and 14 are refusals.

Before this actor enters the world it has no eyes, so no scene, token, move or door reaches this seat. The party ROSTER still does, and so does the sitting where a golden has one (adventure-night has no session at all). Narration would too -- classify forwards it unconditionally -- but NO golden in this corpus has a narration before a party member is added, so nothing here demonstrates it. Roster-gated exposure is recorded by sub-project 14's plan as a product question rather than a sight leak.

This directory is also that plan's ORACLE for this character: what its log must contain once the projection moves to write time. It records today's code, and the port is checked against it.
